description: This Python source file defines a configuration class 'HostedVLLMChatConfig' for a hosted VLLM chat system. It includes methods for handling supported parameters, mapping parameters, determining file types (such as videos), converting files to video URLs, and transforming messages (including replacing file references with URLs). The class inherits from 'OpenAIGPTConfig' and is part of a module that facilitates translation between OpenAI compatible chat APIs and VLLM's implementation.
